title: SMProfile-BdeConfirmation payload (NATS, MQTT)
description: GENERATED from standard/profiles/operations/bde-confirmation.json 1.1.0 by i3x-v5 packages/schemas-ci/gen-payloads.mjs; do not edit by hand. Shape: entity (envelope.schema.json).

confirmation_no.description: The booking's own identity (e.g. BDE-2026-08-03-2208427). UNIQUE per confirmation — this is what makes the grain safe to key, where production_order_no repeats.

production_order_no.description: The production order this booking confirms (RESPONDS_TO). NOT the identity at this grain — many confirmations share one order.

machine_ref.description: Executing machine (machine_no). MEASURED 2026-08-03: non-null on 2000 of 2000 rows at this grain across 81 distinct values, where the per-production-order aggregate carries it on only 32 of 100. The machine binding survives here and is lost there.

operation_no.description: The routing operation (Arbeitsgang) this booking belongs to. MEASURED: 1714 of 2000 rows, 30 distinct. Absent on the rest — a booking without an operation is not an error here, and it must stay absent rather than default to a first operation.

shift.description: Shift of record for the booking, derived upstream from machine_departments x machine_pools x shift_config x shift_weekly_pattern (sim-v5, 2026-08-03). Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/bde-confirmation.md, attributes › shift › description.

good_qty.description: Pieces booked as good on this confirmation.

scrap_qty.description: Pieces booked as scrap on this confirmation. The ERP half of the quantity axis — the counterpart the machine's own part_scrap counter is reconciled against.

rework_qty.description: Pieces booked for rework — a THIRD disposition, deliberately not folded into scrap (same rule as the part_scrap semantic in standard/mappings/attribute-aliases.json). Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/bde-confirmation.md, attributes › rework_qty › description.

scrap_reason.description: Reason code for the scrap on this booking. MEASURED: only 123 of 2000 rows carry one, with 2 distinct values (cavity-defect, quality-fail). Thin by nature — most bookings have no scrap at all — so a consumer must treat absence as 'no reason recorded', never as a category.

labor_min.description: Personnel minutes booked against this confirmation. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/bde-confirmation.md, attributes › labor_min › description.

machine_min.description: Machine minutes booked against this confirmation.

setup_min.description: Setup minutes booked against this confirmation. MEASURED: non-zero on 25 of 800 rows — setup is an event, not a per-booking constant, so a zero here is a real 'no setup on this booking'.

cycle_time_actual_sec.description: Actually measured cycle time per piece (s) for this booking.

actual_start_time.description: Start of the booked interval (ts_start). Absent at the per-production-order grain.

updated_at.description: Last change (recorded_at). Server-managed and volatile on every read.
